facts.title: No glutamate

facts.title: Order by phone
facts.text: Orders are taken by phone only.

highlights.title: Eight classics
highlights.intro: Dishes that define the kitchen. Names stay as printed on the German menu.

chicken.name: Knuspriges Hähnchen
chicken.description: Crisp fried chicken breast, with noodles, rice, or from the wok.
chicken.alt: Crispy fried chicken with a dipping sauce

rolls.name: Frühlingsrollen
rolls.description: Summer rolls, spring rolls and vegetarian mini rolls.
rolls.alt: Vietnamese summer rolls with prawns, rice noodles and two dipping sauces

noodles.name: Gebratene Nudeln
noodles.description: Fried noodles with egg and vegetables, plain or with a crisp topping.
noodles.alt: Stir-fried noodles with vegetables on a wooden plate

rice.name: Gebratener Reis
rice.description: Fried rice with egg and vegetables.
rice.alt: Plate of fried rice with egg, peas and vegetables

beef.name: Rindfleisch Spezial
beef.description: Beef from the wok, as pho, or in a Vietnamese bowl.
beef.alt: Sliced beef with herbs, chilli and peanuts

duck.name: Ente Knusprig
duck.description: With tomato, onion, pineapple, red curry and a hot tom yum sweet-and-sour sauce.
duck.alt: Sliced crispy duck with cucumber, leek, pancakes and sauces

curry.name: Vegetarisches Curry
curry.description: Vegetables in red curry with coconut milk, served with rice.
curry.alt: Red curry with vegetables, Thai basil and chilli

drinks.name: Getränke
drinks.description: Mineral water, juices and soft drinks, plus beer and wine to take away.
drinks.alt: Glass of iced tea with ice, lime and mint

hours.title: Opening Hours
hours.intro: Lunch and evening on weekdays, evening on Sundays and public holidays. The kitchen is closed on Saturdays.
hours.note: For celebrations we can be reached outside these hours by arrangement.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Orders by phone only. There is no online ordering.
contact.mapTitle: Map: Hanoi Asia Imbiss, Harthäuser Hauptstraße 35, 70794 Filderstadt
contact.party: For parties and the catering service, please call.
contact.takeaway: Every dish is also available to take away.

home.visitText: The imbiss is on Harthäuser Hauptstraße in Filderstadt. A phone call is enough to order.

menu.title: Menu
menu.intro: Dishes stay in the wording of the printed German menu. Variants with their own price are separate rows.
menu.vat: Dining in is subject to an additional 19% VAT.
menu.wish: We cook to your taste. Please ask.
menu.legendNote: Not every ingredient can be listed. Please tell us when you order if you have an allergy or intolerance.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.controllerBody: The controller for this website is the owner named on the legal notice page.
privacy.siteBody: These pages show the menu, opening hours and contact details. There is no online ordering and no guest account. No analytics or advertising tools are used.
privacy.hostBody: When you open the site, the hosting provider may process connection data that is technically required, in particular the IP address, date and time, and the address requested. The legal basis is Article 6 (1) (f) GDPR, the operation and security of the website.
privacy.localBody: This browser can store the chosen language and a notice for the bar above the navigation. After a sign-in to the unlinked admin area, a session flag is stored on that device as well. No order data is sent. You can delete these entries in your browser settings.
privacy.mapBody: The contact page embeds a Google map. When it loads, Google Ireland Limited may process the IP address and set cookies.
privacy.phoneBody: Tapping a number opens the phone app on your device. No form is sent through this website.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Please contact the address given in the legal notice.
